candidates.title: Kyren Williams Receptions Ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.05 per reception recorded by Kyren Williams during the Los Angeles R vs Washington Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 8, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.05 per reception constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 20 receptions. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Payouts are proportional to the size of the holder's position. For example, 8 receptions pays Yes $0.40 and No $0.60; 11 receptions pays Yes $0.55 and No $0.45; zero receptions pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.
